rationale: After making a new session high at $15.29 (1.06% MFE), TTD failed to sustain the breakout and has round-tripped back to the entry level ($15.14), slipping below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($15.17) and the recent 1-minute consolidation floor at $15.18. With the broader market slightly pulling back from its highs (SPY down from +2.69% to +2.55%) and momentum stalling into the final 50 minutes of the session, closing the position preserves capital and avoids taking a loss on a failed breakout.
